comparison.objective: Lower a hoisted motor onto four base studs while steering the suspended load.
comparison.physical_skill: Pendant control, load guidance, four-hole alignment, and safe landing under gravity.
comparison.success_condition: All feet are flat over studs, chain is slack, robot is clear, and no pinch/strike gate was violated.
comparison.reason: Both test separated alignment sites, but the motor task centers on hoist coordination and suspended-load safety; it does not test spring latching, telescoping rail retention, handed orientation, or screw fastening.
